svg.title: Power curves for three minimum detectable lifts
svg.desc: Line chart for an 18 percent baseline rate. The 80 percent power line is reached at about 6,036, 2,735, and 1,567 visitors per group for lifts of 2, 3, and 4 percentage points respectively. Only part of the 2-point curve is visible because it needs more than 5,000 visitors per group.
